observations.name: Application Layer Protocol
observations.justification: Found 1 IP addresses in the configuration. These are likely command and control (C2) servers used for communication (T1071).

observations.name: Screen Capture
observations.justification: The malware string 'CopyFromScreen' was found in the binary. This string is characteristic of Screen Capture behavior. The presence of this specific string alone (no other Screen Capture-related string corroborates it) indicates the malware has capabilities associated with this technique, but with less certainty than a corroborated combination would.

observations.name: Virtualization/Sandbox Evasion
observations.justification: Found 1 mutex names in the configuration. Mutexes are often used to check for a running instance (single-instance enforcement) and for sandbox detection (T1497).
